description: Delete one saved memory for this learner, chosen by project_id and kind.

kind.description: Kind of the memory to delete. Example: "study_preference" or "project_learning_context".

project_id.description: UUID of the project memory to delete, or null. Example: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. Omit or null to delete a learner-wide memory.

name: delete-memory

deleted.description: Always true when the delete succeeds.

projectId.description: Owning project UUID, or null for global memory.

userId.description: Owner of the deleted memory document.

title: Delete Studocu Agent Memory
